run_parse_and_cache_all_pairs: run the cli to parse and cache image pairs for the habitat_release dataset
create_PairsDataset: create a PairsDataset instance from dataset names with optional transforms and normalization
load_pairs_from_cache_file: load image pairs from a cache file with two space-separated paths per line
load_pairs_from_list_file: load image pairs from a list file by appending _1.jpg and _2.jpg suffixes
write_cache_file: write image pairs to a cache file with relative paths from a root directory
